translations.web: “ ‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s sister. She is your father’s near kinswoman.
translations.bsb: You must not have sexual relations with your father’s sister; she is your father’s close relative.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's sister: she is thy father's near kinswoman.
